c74object.name: evi_teeth
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP teeth~ filter delay
c74object.description:
evi_teeth is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_teeth.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_approx.genexpr
evi_teeth is also available in MSP as: evi.teeth~.
Comb filter delay unit with independent control of feedforward and feedback delay times and saturation in the feedback path. The same structure as MSP teeth~, but with cubic interpolation (softer in the high end) and no digital clipping at FB Gain == 1 (via internal saturation, which makes the whole filter softer but will not clip your precious audio).

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ input, feedforward, feedback, direct, feedforward, feedback } }

geninlet.name: feedforward
geninlet.digest: Delay in ms @min 0 @max 1000. Feedforward delay time in ms.

geninlet.name: feedback
geninlet.digest: Delay in ms @min 0 @max 1000. Feedback delay time in ms.

geninlet.name: direct
geninlet.digest: Gain Coefficient @min -1 @max 1. Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the input path.

geninlet.name: feedforward
geninlet.digest: Coefficient @min -1 @max 1. Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedforward path.

geninlet.name: feedback
geninlet.digest: Coefficient @min -1 @max 1. Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedback path.
